platformRestInst.description:
The source control gadget to use in case app info needs to be retrieved from
the centralized code analytics repository.

rootPkgName.description: The name of the root {@link Pkg} to retrieve {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.AppInfo} for.

semanticVersion.description:
The version of #rootPkgName to retrieve {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.AppInfo} for.
The [pre-release components](SemanticVersion#preReleaseVersion) and
[build metadata](SemanticVersion#buildMetadata) are ignored; the latest
available [app info](BaseCodeAnalysis.AppInfo) for the `major.minor.patch`
version is always used.

zipFile.description:
The file to write the fetched content to. If no file is provided, a file in the {@link TmpFileSystem}
will be created and returned.
